title: Conduit: An Experience Data Plane for Distributed Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.24456v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distributed reinforcement learning (RL) scales training by parallelizing actors and learners around an Experience Buffer. As RL workloads grow, however, the buffer becomes more than a replay queue: it is the storage substrate of a large-capacity, latency-critical experience path that every iteration traverses to move, transform, sample, and batch experiences before learner updates can begin. Existing RL systems embed this path inside framework control flow or expose it as a request-driven buffer service, leaving experience placement fixed and experience-path work difficult to schedule independently as a runtime-level optimization target. We present Conduit, a framework-agnostic runtime that exposes RL experience management as an explicit systems optimization problem. translated_title: Conduit：面向分布式强化学习的经验数据平面
translated_abstract: 分布式强化学习（RL）通过围绕经验缓冲区并行化执行者和学习者来扩展训练规模。然而，随着RL工作负载的增长，缓冲区不再仅仅是一个重放队列：它是一个大容量、延迟关键的经验路径的存储基底，每一次迭代都必须 traverses 这条路径来移动、转换、采样和批量处理经验，之后学习者的更新才能开始。现有的RL系统要么将这条路径嵌入到框架控制流中，要么将其暴露为请求驱动的缓冲区服务，这导致经验放置固定不变，且经验路径上的工作难以作为一个运行时级别的优化目标被独立调度。我们提出了Conduit，一个与框架无关的运行时，它将RL经验管理暴露为一个显式的系统优化问题。其核心是经验数据平面，这是一个运行时抽象，通过暴露……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Conduit——一个与框架无关的运行时系统，其核心是经验数据平面（EDP）抽象，将分布式强化学习中的经验管理从框架执行逻辑中解耦出来，使其成为可独立调度的显式系统级优化目标。
en_tdlr: Conduit is a framework-agnostic runtime built around the Experience Data Plane (EDP) abstraction, which decouples RL experience management from framework-specific execution logic, turning experience handling into an explicit, independently schedulable systems-level optimization target for distributed reinforcement learning.
